attach_unique_array: attach unique values to a numpy array by caching them in dtype metadata
attach_unique_multiple_arrays: attach unique values to multiple numpy arrays and return as a tuple
cached_unique_array: retrieve cached unique values from a numpy array's dtype metadata
cached_unique_multiple_arrays: retrieve cached unique values from multiple numpy arrays' dtype metadata
cached_unique_with_namespace: retrieve unique values using a precomputed array namespace module
